description: This file defines an abstract Controller class in the Goteo core namespace, providing common functionalities like rendering responses, redirecting, handling forms, and dispatching events for web application controllers.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: An abstract class providing common methods for web controllers in the Goteo framework, including response handling, form creation, event dispatching, and database access.

methods.name: viewResponse
methods.description: Renders a view with specified variables, returns an HTTP Response, dynamically setting JSON content type for AJAX or debug mode.

methods.name: rawResponse
methods.description: Returns a plain or file download HTTP response with the specified string, content type, status, and optional filename for download.

methods.name: jsonResponse
methods.description: Returns a JSON HTTP response with the given variables, formatted prettily in debug mode.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Creates and handles a sub-request to forward to another controller within the application.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Returns a redirect HTTP response to the specified path or current request URI.

methods.name: dbCache
methods.description: Provides access to database caching functionality.

methods.name: dbReplica
methods.description: Provides access to a database replica.

methods.name: getViewEngine
methods.description: Retrieves the current view engine used for rendering views.

methods.name: contextVars
methods.description: Adds context variables to all views, optionally specifying a view path context.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves a specific service from the application's service container.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event via the application's event dispatcher.

methods.name: createFormBuilder
methods.description: Creates and configures a new form builder instance with default options.

methods.name: getModelForm
methods.description: Creates and returns a form processor for a model, including validation handling based on the request.

methods.name: getEntityForm
methods.description: Creates and returns a form processor for an entity, similar to getModelForm, with validation.
